Name: DustBeauty's Rustic Country Walls and Floors for Alternative Textures
Author: Zyrnathos
Description:
[center][size=4][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/505AIXP.png[/img]

Disclaimer: All assets in this mod are NOT MINE!
[/b][/size]They were taken directly from DustBeauty's original which can be found[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5857] here[/url].[/center]

This is a conversion of Dustbeauty's Rustic Country Walls and Floors to be usable with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. It allows you to apply the walls and floors textures without completely replacing them, thereby letting you keep vanilla ones as well.

I made this for personal use as despite having searched high and low for one, there wasn't any functional AT pack available for the mod. The closest one I found was made by [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-96]nehriee[/url] on the official forum with the following remark that, as far as I'm aware, no one replied to:
[quote]"I tried making an alternative textures conversion for DustBeauty's rustic country walls & floors mod but i keep getting an error".. does anyone know what the reason might be? ;_; please lmk; thanks everyone!!![/quote]
Someone in the main mod's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5857?tab=posts]post[/url] section also apparently made one but refused to share it. So, I decided to just do it myself.

Since [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty [/url]hasn't been active since July, 2021, I presume she might've quitted modding, SDV, or both (or maybe is simply very busy). I'd love to see an official conversion or ask her to publish mine, but as those don't seem possible atm, I'm invoking her third permission rule:
[quote]If my mod is broken by new game updates, and your contact send to me is not answered for more than a month, you can share the conversion or your fixed file for the benefits of others.[/quote]The original isn't necessarily "broken", but at least this conversion will be, hopefully, beneficial to those looking for, well, alternatives to CP.
I'll therefore be more than happy to delete it immediately at her request and/or if the permission rule above is revoked.
[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6FNMsP3.png[/img][/center]

[color=#ffff00][b]**IMPORTANT**[/b] [/color][b][u]As an AT content pack, it requires the tool "paint bucket"[/u][/b] which comes with the Alternative Textures mod itself.
You'll have to buy one for 500g from Robin. See [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]this page[/url] for more detail. Also see [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OzCzEppsXVY]this video[/url] by Aster555 on how to use it.

Please follow these steps to ensure smooth usage:
[list=1]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].﻿
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Extract all into your Stardew mod folder. By default, it should be [i]C:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i]

[*]Don't forget to purchase the paint bucket (see above)!
[/list][center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aJWbekg.png[/img][/center]
